This is increasingly common, especially for younger generations. 5. **Add a personal touch** Write a short blessing (e.g., “学业进步” for academic progress, “健康快乐” for health and happiness) on the envelope if custom allows. 6. **Time of giving** Traditionally, hóngbāo are given during family reunions on New Year’s Eve or during visits in the first days of the New Year. You still have time to prepare before the festival. If you’re really short on time, focus on the gesture—the blessing and goodwill are more important than perfection. Happy Spring Festival! 🧧
